lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice mediating information from a short source into a helpful recommendation.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Helping a friend understand a short article about choosing a health app or digital service.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing source information and recommending a practical next step.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a short consumer article about choosing a digital health service and decide what advice to pass on.

main_focus.name: summary plus recommendation with därför skulle jag
main_focus.description: Connect a summarized source point to a careful recommendation without sounding too forceful.
model_examples: Artikeln säger att säkerheten är viktigast.
Därför skulle jag välja en tjänst med tydlig information.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use summary-to-recommendation language naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: source framing with artikeln säger att
hedging with jag skulle nog and det verkar

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical digital-service vocabulary and cautious recommendation chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks for help turning a short article into advice.
dialogue_shape.middle: They identify the main point, mention one limitation, and form a careful recommendation.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide what advice to give and why.

target_complexity.repetition: summary and recommendation frames should recur with natural variation

focus: the main point from the consumer article
the limitation or concern that affects the advice

sentence_focus: one sentence reporting what an article says
one cautious recommendation with skulle nog
one sentence explaining a reason with därför
one sentence with a relative clause using som
one sentence naming a limitation or concern
